desc: Place a Wind Gate at target location. You may cast Wind Gate: Evacuate on an ally to pull them to your Wind Gate.

name: Wind Gate: Evacuate
desc: Target an ally to pull them to your Wind Gate.

name: Wind Shift
desc: Increases your spell haste by 2% and reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 25%. (up to 2 ranks)

name: Wind's Grace
desc: Body of Lightning and Cloudburst increases your dodge chance by %.

name: Windride
desc: You call upon the wind to bring a friendly party or raid member to your location.

name: Windsurf
desc: Command your Air Elemental to windsurf to you, intercepting the next melee or ranged attack made against you, and allowing you to cast Shock and Aeroblast while moving.

name: Wrath of Al'Akir
desc: Depleting Static extends the duration of your Unshackle by sec.
